mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tenant) AS tenantCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workplace WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'ACTIVE') AS workplaceCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM department WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'ACTIVE') AS departmentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS employeeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee_work_rule WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS workRuleCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee_external_mapping WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'ACTIVE') AS externalMappingCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shift_template WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_active = 1) AS shiftTemplateCount
